why_this_file_exists: The mission asked for '12 tasks x 30 new seeds'. The OFFICIAL installed protocol cannot produce 30: RoboDojo task/RoboDojo/config/_task.yml:105-107 sets eval_nums: 25 and src/eval_client/main.py:325-329 clamps eval_num = min(EVAL_NUM, eval_nums), so EVAL_NUM can only LOWER the count. Per the mission spec ('if the official protocol differs, lock an equivalent contract beforehand') this file locks the equivalent contract BEFORE any FINAL episode is run. No official rule, config or success predicate is modified.

official_evidence.success_source: task/RoboDojo/tasks/<task>.py run_reward + env/reward_manager/reward_manager.py:527-587 + src/eval_client/eval_env.py:882-901 (env.success set only there)
official_evidence.seed_source: env/seed_manager/seed_manager.py:37-70: a 'seed' is a LAYOUT DIRECTORY Assets/Eval_Layout/RoboDojo/arx_x5/<seed>/; 55 <task>_<n>.json layouts exist in each of dirs 0,1,2
official_evidence.control_rate: 25 Hz (env_cfg/arx_x5.yml:10 collect_freq plus env/observation_manager/obs_manager.py:37-43 collect_interval) against 250 Hz physics (env_cfg/sim/sim_config.yml:1-2)

frozen_final_protocol.rationale_for_25: the official default; using 25 keeps every number comparable to a stock RoboDojo run and avoids editing _task.yml
frozen_final_protocol.optional_larger_sample: if more episodes are wanted, the SAME frozen protocol is repeated on seed dirs 0 and 2 (75 total per task) and reported as 'official 25 x 3 layout dirs'; the macro headline uses the primary dir only
frozen_final_protocol.success_definition: the official verdict only: env.success[i] set by src/eval_client/eval_env.py:895-897 when reward > 1-1e-3; unstable envs excluded from the denominator exactly as main.py:831-835 does
frozen_final_protocol.ci_method: Wilson score interval 95% per task; macro = unweighted mean of per-task success rates; macro CI = bootstrap over tasks AND episodes (10000 resamples, seed 0), reported alongside the plain mean
frozen_final_protocol.data_isolation: FINAL layouts are never used for training or model selection; the frozen DEV cohort (16 episodes) and TRAIN split are separate files (data/split80.json)
freeze_requirements_before_the_first_fin: checkpoint directory + MANIFEST.json sha256 for every file
this contract's own sha256 and the git commit that contains it
the exact command line, the eval client version (RoboDojo b8e5eed), and the layout dir
the policy metadata (r42_metadata.json incl. normalizer_sha256) and the codec mode
forbidden: changing any task module, config or success predicate
re-running a FINAL episode to get a better outcome (one attempt per layout, recorded)
using FINAL outcomes to pick a checkpoint, prompt, threshold or epoch
reporting a number produced with a different layout dir as if it were the frozen one

macro: unweighted mean success rate over the 12 tasks
explicit FAILED_CAPABILITY if the research target (>=3/25 each, macro >=25%) is not met
latency: policy inference p50/p95/p99 measured in-process (4 phases) and end-to-end RTT at the client
resources: GPU seconds booked in the WAL for the FINAL job
videos retained and hashed, not uploaded

target_not_official.note: this is a research goal stated by the mission, NOT an official benchmark requirement; failing it must be reported as FAILED_CAPABILITY with the real numbers, never hidden
